title: Depression check-ins and follow-up

title: What type 2 diabetes means
text: Type 2 diabetes involves insufficient insulin or reduced effectiveness of insulin, which can leave blood glucose higher than it should be. This general education does not diagnose an individual or recommend treatment.

title: What depression means
text: Depression is a health condition involving persistent low mood and sometimes loss of interest, sleep changes or low energy. This general education does not diagnose an individual or recommend treatment.

title: What hypertension means
text: Hypertension is another name for high blood pressure. Measurements and clinician review are part of understanding it. This general education does not diagnose an individual or recommend treatment.
